```{r load-rmats}
SIG_THRESHOLD  <- 0.05
DPSI_THRESHOLD <- 0.1
EVENT_TYPES    <- c("SE", "RI", "MXE", "A5SS", "A3SS")

calc_mean_counts <- function(count_str) {
  if (all(is.na(count_str))) return(NA)
  sapply(strsplit(as.character(count_str), ","), function(x) {
    mean(as.numeric(x), na.rm = TRUE)
  })
}

load_rmats_master_table <- function(dir_path, invert_dpsi = TRUE) {

  load_one_event_type <- function(ev) {
    f <- file.path(dir_path, paste0(ev, ".MATS.JC.txt"))
    if (!file.exists(f)) {
      warning(sprintf("Missing file: %s - skipped.", f))
      return(NULL)
    }

    df <- read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA", "NaN", "null"))
    coord_cols <- grep("Start_0base$|End$|ES$|EE$", names(df), value = TRUE)

    df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        EventType = ev,
        p_val     = as.numeric(PValue),
        p_val_adj = as.numeric(FDR),
        dPSI      = if (invert_dpsi) -as.numeric(IncLevelDifference) else as.numeric(IncLevelDifference),
        Position  = apply(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(coord_cols)), 1, paste, collapse = "-"),
        Event_ID  = paste(EventType, chr, strand, Position, sep = "_"),
        mean_IJC_1 = calc_mean_counts(IJC_SAMPLE_1),
        mean_SJC_1 = calc_mean_counts(SJC_SAMPLE_1),
        mean_IJC_2 = calc_mean_counts(IJC_SAMPLE_2),
        mean_SJC_2 = calc_mean_counts(SJC_SAMPLE_2)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter((mean_IJC_1 + mean_SJC_1 >= 30) | (mean_IJC_2 + mean_SJC_2 >= 30)) %>%
      dplyr::rename(Chr = chr, Strand_Info = strand, Gene_ID = GeneID, Gene_Name = geneSymbol) %>%
      dplyr::select(Event_ID, EventType, Chr, Position, Strand_Info, Gene_ID, Gene_Name,
                    p_val, p_val_adj, dPSI)
  }

  combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(EVENT_TYPES, load_one_event_type))

  if (nrow(combined) == 0 || !"p_val_adj" %in% names(combined)) {
    stop(sprintf("Missing rMATS file here: %s", dir_path))
  }

  n_dup <- sum(duplicated(combined$Event_ID))
  if (n_dup > 0) warning(sprintf("%d duplicated Event_ID in %s directory.", n_dup, dir_path))

  combined %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(p_val_adj)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p_val_adj, dplyr::desc(abs(dPSI)))
}

rmats_base_dir <- "/home/akos/Desktop/lab/TDK/rmats"
comparisons    <- c("CTR_vs_TIS", "TIS_vs_REPOP", "CTR_vs_REPOP")

load_all_comparisons <- function(cell_line) {
  setNames(
    lapply(comparisons, function(cmp) {
      load_rmats_master_table(file.path(rmats_base_dir, cell_line, cmp, "output"))
    }),
    comparisons
  )
}

mcf7_tables <- load_all_comparisons("mcf7")
t47d_tables <- load_all_comparisons("t47d")

get_sig_ids <- function(master_data) {
  master_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < SIG_THRESHOLD, abs(dPSI) > DPSI_THRESHOLD) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Event_ID)
}

sig_ids_mcf7 <- lapply(mcf7_tables, get_sig_ids)
sig_ids_t47d <- lapply(t47d_tables, get_sig_ids)

# unique significant events (pooled over comparisons) - needed for Fig 7A
get_sig_unique <- function(tables) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(tables, function(df) {
    df %>% dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < SIG_THRESHOLD, abs(dPSI) > DPSI_THRESHOLD)
  })) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Event_ID, EventType)
}
mcf7_sig_unique <- get_sig_unique(mcf7_tables)
t47d_sig_unique <- get_sig_unique(t47d_tables)
```

```{r fig6-violin}
# Figure 6: CTR vs TIS dPSI distributions
plot_dpsi_asymmetry <- function(master_data, y_limits = c(-1.15, 1.15)) {
  sig_data <- master_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < SIG_THRESHOLD, abs(dPSI) > DPSI_THRESHOLD)

  ggplot(sig_data, aes(x = EventType, y = dPSI, fill = EventType)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, color = NA, trim = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, outlier.size = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("SE" = "#4292C6", "RI" = "#EF3B2C",
                                 "MXE" = "#41AB5D", "A3SS" = "#807DBA", "A5SS" = "#F16913")) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5)) +
    labs(y = "CTR vs TIS \u0394PSI", x = "Event Type") +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Arial", base_size = 18) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
          axis.text  = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"))
}

p_asym_mcf7 <- plot_dpsi_asymmetry(mcf7_tables[["CTR_vs_TIS"]])
p_asym_t47d <- plot_dpsi_asymmetry(t47d_tables[["CTR_vs_TIS"]])

fig_asymmetry <- (p_asym_mcf7 | p_asym_t47d) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A",
                  theme = theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold")))
print(fig_asymmetry)

ggsave("dPSI_asymmetry_TIS_clean.png", fig_asymmetry,
       width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r fig7A-donut}
plot_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  mcf7_sig_unique %>% dplyr::select(EventType) %>% dplyr::mutate(CellLine = "MCF7"),
  t47d_sig_unique %>% dplyr::select(EventType) %>% dplyr::mutate(CellLine = "T47D")
) %>%
  dplyr::count(CellLine, EventType, name = "Count") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CellLine) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Prop = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

make_donut <- function(df, title_text) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = 2, y = Prop, fill = EventType)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y", start = 0) +
    xlim(0.6, 2.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("SE" = "#4292C6", "RI" = "#EF3B2C", "MXE" = "#41AB5D",
                 "A3SS" = "#807DBA", "A5SS" = "#F16913"),
      name = "Event types", drop = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(title = title_text) +
    theme_void(base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12, margin = margin(b = 4)),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key.size = unit(4, "mm"),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, "mm")
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = ifelse(Prop > 0.02, scales::percent(Prop, accuracy = 0.1), "")),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 2.9, fontface = "bold", color = "#222222", family = "Arial"
    )
}

p_mcf7 <- make_donut(dplyr::filter(plot_data, CellLine == "MCF7"), "MCF7") + labs(tag = "A")
p_t47d <- make_donut(dplyr::filter(plot_data, CellLine == "T47D"), "T47D")

panel_A_grid <- (p_mcf7 + guide_area() + p_t47d) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 0.35, 1), guides = "collect") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(family = "Arial", face = "bold", size = 16))

print(panel_A_grid)
ggsave("panel_A_splicing_types.png", panel_A_grid,
       width = 160, height = 65, units = "mm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r fig7B-euler}
sig_mcf7_clean <- setNames(sig_ids_mcf7, c("CTR vs\nTIS", "TIS vs\nREPOP", "CTR vs\nREPOP"))
sig_t47d_clean <- setNames(sig_ids_t47d, c("CTR vs\nTIS", "TIS vs\nREPOP", "CTR vs\nREPOP"))

make_euler_panel_clean <- function(sets, title_text) {
  fit <- euler(sets)
  p <- plot(
    fit,
    quantities = list(cex = 1.4, fontfamily = "Arial"),
    labels     = list(cex = 1.35, fontfamily = "Arial"),
    edges      = list(lwd = 1.0, col = "black"),
    fills      = list(fill = c("#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6"), alpha = 0.7),
    padding    = grid::unit(1.5, "lines"),
    adjust_labels = FALSE
  )
  wrap_elements(p) +
    ggtitle(title_text) +
    theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 26,
                                    lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(b = 10)),
          plot.margin = margin(5, 15, 5, 15))
}

p_mcf7_all  <- make_euler_panel_clean(sig_mcf7_clean, "MCF7\nSplicing events")
p_t47d_all  <- make_euler_panel_clean(sig_t47d_clean, "T47D\nSplicing events")
p_mcf7_t47d <- make_euler_panel_clean(
  list(MCF7 = unique(unlist(sig_ids_mcf7)),
       T47D = unique(unlist(sig_ids_t47d))),
  "MCF7 vs T47D\nShared splicing events"
)

p_mcf7_tagged <- p_mcf7_all + labs(tag = "B")

fig_euler_all <- (p_mcf7_tagged | p_t47d_all | p_mcf7_t47d) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1.15)) &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(family = "Arial", face = "bold", size = 46),
        plot.tag.position = c(0.06, 0.94))

print(fig_euler_all)
ggsave("panel_B_euler_mcf7_t47d.png", fig_euler_all,
       width = 20, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r fig7C-euler}
sets_mcf7_c <- list("CTR vs\nTIS"   = sig_ids_mcf7[["CTR_vs_TIS"]],
                    "TIS vs\nREPOP" = sig_ids_mcf7[["TIS_vs_REPOP"]])
sets_t47d_c <- list("CTR vs\nTIS"   = sig_ids_t47d[["CTR_vs_TIS"]],
                    "TIS vs\nREPOP" = sig_ids_t47d[["TIS_vs_REPOP"]])

make_euler_c_panel <- function(sets, title_text) {
  fit <- euler(sets)
  p <- plot(
    fit,
    quantities = list(cex = 1.5, fontfamily = "Arial"),
    labels     = list(cex = 1.5, fontfamily = "Arial"),
    edges      = list(lwd = 1.0, col = "black"),
    fills      = list(fill = c("#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1"), alpha = 0.75),
    padding    = grid::unit(1.5, "lines"),
    adjust_labels = FALSE
  )
  wrap_elements(p) +
    ggtitle(title_text) +
    theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 32,
                                    lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(b = 10)),
          plot.margin = margin(5, 20, 5, 20))
}

p_c_mcf7 <- make_euler_c_panel(sets_mcf7_c, "MCF7") + labs(tag = "C")
p_c_t47d <- make_euler_c_panel(sets_t47d_c, "T47D")

panel_C <- (p_c_mcf7 | p_c_t47d) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Shared TIS and REPOP splicing events") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(family = "Arial", face = "bold", size = 46),
        plot.tag.position = c(0.045, 0.94),
        plot.title = element_text(family = "Arial", face = "bold", size = 22,
                                  hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 12)))

print(panel_C)
ggsave("panel_C_shared_events_matching_B.png", panel_C,
       width = 20, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
